svg.text: A100 · SWA atom DiT block · training · d 128, cond 128, 4 heads × 32, bf16
forward (the inference stages, saving the backward's operands: a, X, PQ, PK, q1, att, y, ffn, lse)
a = rn(silu(c)); mod = a Wmodᵀ # fp32 [rows, 768]
F2 · RMS-adaLN, q | k | v | g, head RMS norm, RoPE
as I2; also stores X = x and the pre-norm Pq, Pk (bf16)
as I3; lse = ln Σ exp(s) per sample, head, query
as I4; also stores q1, att = rn(gated Woᵀ), y, ffn = rn(h Wdᵀ)
HBM (sizes at N = 3072 atoms, A = 48, a conditioning per atom)
q, c, out, a, Q, K, V, G, O, X, PQ, PK, q1, att, y, ffn
backward (stage by stage in reverse; every row stage writes its columns of the modulation gradient once; the weight gradients are cuBLAS GEMMs)
dffn = rn(dy · rn(gate_f)); d gate_f = dy · ffn
a | b = y Wuᵀ (recomputed); h = rn(a sigmoid(a) b)
dh = dffn Wd; da | db = swiglu′(a, b) · dh
B2 · FFN backward, input side + adaLN
dy′ = dab Wu; x̂ = q1 · rstd
d scale_f = dy′ x̂; d shift_f = dy′
dq1 = dy + rstd (dy′ (1 + scale_f) − x̂ mean(dy′ (1 + scale_f) x̂))
datt = rn(dq1 rn(gate_a)); dgated = datt Wo; d gate_a = dq1 att
dO = rn(dgated σ(G)); dG = rn(dgated O σ(G)(1 − σ(G)))
D = Σhead dO · O # the attention backward's row term
p = exp(s − lse); dp = dO·vᵀ; ds = rn(p (dp − D))
dQ = scale · ds K; dK = scale · dsᵀ Q; dV = rn(p)ᵀ dO
B5 · q | k | v | g backward, RMS-adaLN backward
dPq,k = rn(head_rms_bwd(P, unrope(dQ, dK))); dPv,g = dV, dG
dx = dP W; d scale_a = dx x̂; d shift_a = dx
dq = rn(dq1 + rstd (dx(1 + scale_a) − x̂ mean(dx(1 + scale_a) x̂)))
q, PQ, PK, dQ, dK, dV, dG, dq1
mod cols 0 .. 255, cos, sin, Wqkv | Wg
dWqkv = dPqkvᵀ X; dWg = dPgᵀ X; dWo = dattᵀ gated
dc = silu′(c) · rn(dmod Wmod); dWmod = dmodᵀ a # dmod fp32 as hi + lo bf16 terms
per-sample conditioning: one dmod row per row of c; shared: summed over 16 samples in-kernel
HBM (sizes at N = 3072 atoms, A = 48, a conditioning per atom)
dy, dq1, dO, dG, dQ, dK, dV, dq, datt, gated, dffn
